Caruso is the AI-native fund administration platform for private markets. We replace legacy systems with modern software and integrated services, helping fund managers save time, impress investors, and grow AUM.
Since launching just over two years ago, Caruso has grown rapidly to $100B+ in assets, 900+ funds, and 80,000+ investors on the platform. We just completed our Series A capital raise, and are looking for smart, ambitious people to help us build a global business.

## Role summary
We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer (Agentic) to help us build software with AI at the core of the engineering workflow.
This role is for someone who wants to move from customer problem to shipped product, using AI agents and modern tooling as a force multiplier across backend, frontend, and product work.

## What you’ll do
- Work across Go services, GraphQL and gRPC APIs, TypeScript and Next.js applications, AWS infrastructure, and AI-enabled workflows.
- Build products and systems across investor onboarding, fund operations, registry workflows, internal tooling, and investor experiences.
- Use high-end agentic tooling and frontier models as part of day-to-day development.
- Own meaningful domains in small teams with autonomy, trust, and clear business impact.
- Work closely with engineering, product, design, and operations.

## What we’re looking for
- This role is usually a good fit for someone with a few years of commercial experience, but we care more about capability than titles.
- Experience with Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.
- Interest in AI-assisted and agentic development.
- Strong product mindset, curiosity, and good judgment.
- Comfort working through ambiguity and turning ideas into practical solutions.
- Good communication and collaboration.
- Backgrounds in software, mathematics, physics, engineering, or product-technical roles can all be a strong fit.
You do not need to be a Go specialist. We care about adaptability, product sense, and strong use of modern tools.

## Tech stack
- Go, TypeScript, Next.js, React
- GraphQL, gRPC, Protobuf
- AWS, Fargate, Lambda, Kinesis
- MySQL, DynamoDB, S3
- Terraform, Docker, GitHub, Datadog, Linear

## Why Caruso
- Real scale and real complexity
- High-end agentic tooling and frontier model access
- Strong engineering team and real ownership
- Premium office in Viaduct Harbour
- MacBook Pro, dual screens, Apple peripherals, and AirPods Pro
- Southern Cross health insurance
- Extended parental leave and unlimited sick leave

## Requirement
- Right to work in New Zealand
If you’re excited by the idea of using AI to expand what a small, high-trust team can do, we’d love to hear from you.
